standard-dialogue.npc: Hello friend. You're a long way from Lumbridge!

options.text: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?

steps.player: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?

steps.npc: Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
Apparently he was on a mission to map the area. How foolish is that?

options.text: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.

steps.player: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.

steps.npc: Oh. Oops. Sorry if I sounded rude, it just seems like a really bad idea.
I mean it's a noble calling. Lots of people around here could use a proper map to navigate with. But, you know... there's something not quite right about that jungle.
Best of luck though... Guthix knows, you'll need it.

options.text: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?

steps.player: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?

steps.npc: Not really. Just be careful - there's a lot of weird stuff going on in there lately.

options.text: Have you seen any Kharazi Tribesmen in the jungle?
Ok thanks.
Are you calling me foolish?

steps.npc: Er... maybe? I'll just be on my way...

options.text: What do you do here?
Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I haven't gone into the Kharazi myself, but I've found some interesting tree specimens out here.
If you do find a safe path into the jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to have a nose around in there.

options.text: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
Okay, thanks.
Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?

steps.player: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?

steps.npc: Oh yes, I've met loads of them! Lovely lot. I haven't seen many about recently, though.
If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.

options.text: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?

steps.player: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?

steps.npc: I wish I did! But I just have the one, and I've grown fond of it. Besides, I might need it if I ever get lost in the jungle.

options.text: Will you trade something for it?

steps.player: Will you trade something for it?

steps.npc: Hmm, maybe. Tell you what, you show me something interesting and I'll see if it's worth my Bullroarer. How about that?

options.text: Okay, thanks.
How do I get into the Kharazi jungle?
Ok thanks.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.

steps.player: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.

steps.npc: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing any more. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.

using-items-on-the-jungle-forester-raw-o.npc: Ugh, it's still raw! You can't serve me that. Take it away!

using-items-on-the-jungle-forester-cooke.prompt: Trade your Oomlie Wrap for a Bullroarer?

options.text: Yes

steps.player: I lost my Bullroarer, can I swap this delicious wrap for yours?

steps.npc: Go on then. Forestry is hungry work.

options.text: No

steps.player: On second thoughts, I might get hungry.

using-items-on-the-jungle-forester-anyth.npc: Sorry, but I have no use for that.

swinging-the-bullroarer-near-the-foreste.npc: You'll have better luck getting someone's attention if you use it in the jungle.
